messages.content: Hi pt-1007, Northline Care weekly check. How are you?
Doing good! Question tho—what bread can I eat instead? My doc said to watch it because of my diabetes
I can't give diet advice—that's clinical—but a nurse can walk you through it. Want me to escalate to them?
Connecting you now. Nurse will reach out about bread and diet options. They typically respond within 31 hours.
You're welcome. We'll check in again next week. Take care.
